question: List all customers from Cape Town.
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE city = 'Cape Town';

question: What products are in the Electronics category?
What is the total quantity of items ordered across all orders?
How many orders does each status have?
expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status;

question: What is the average unit price of products in the Books category?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM products WHERE category = 'Books';

question: How many orders were placed by customers in Durban?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Durban';

question: Which customers have placed at least one cancelled order?
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled';

question: What is the total revenue per product category?
expected_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category;

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total amount spent?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the 3 best-selling products by quantity?
expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many orders were placed in the first half of 2025?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-06-30';

question: How many new customers signed up in 2024?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < '2025-01-01';

question: Who are the biggest spenders?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;
